
mgcv remains an R-only extension. Fit it through the derivative-free surrogate workflow; arbitrary R callbacks are not differentiated by JAX. Python-only workflows use built-in intensity families.

Install the matching Python package as described in the README and set
RETICULATE_PYTHON before starting R. These synthetic examples use a projected
CPU grid. Short runs demonstrate the API; assess convergence and sampler
diagnostics before scientific use.

```{r example}
library(DiffiScape)
library(terra)
basis <- rast(nrows = 4L, ncols = 5L, xmin = 0, xmax = 5,
              ymin = 0, ymax = 4, crs = "EPSG:3857",
              vals = seq(0, 1, length.out = 20))
pts <- as.data.frame(xyFromCell(basis, c(1, 3, 3, 5, 8, 12, 15, 18, 20)))
output_dir <- tempdir()
cfg <- default_optimizer_config()
cfg$n_init <- 4L
cfg$n_iter <- 1L
cfg$n_candidates <- 10L
cfg$distribution <- "gam"
cfg$omniscape$radius <- 1L
cfg$omniscape$block_size <- 1L
icfg <- default_intensity_config()
icfg$include_spatial_re <- FALSE
icfg$covariate_type <- "linear"
icfg$bam_discrete <- FALSE
results <- ds_optimize(basis, pts, solver = "surrogate", config = cfg,
  intensity_config = icfg, bounds = list(r_0 = c(1, 5), z_1 = c(-2, 2)),
  output_dir = output_dir)
```
